name: Of Frost and Flowers
source:
In the early world of Gaia, the capability to use magic is determined by birth, creating a rift between magic and non-magic users. 

Yet despite the rift, an organization stepped up with a purpose of making magic accessible to everyone: The Crysmalia Project. 

The story starts with Alto, a craftswoman who joined Zethania's Knights to search for her missing childhood friend. Upon joining them, however, Alto stumbled upon a secret she should not have known, and now her life is on the line..

OFAF is a prequel to [url=http://elseth.itch.io/crysmalia-dawn-of-darkness]Crysmalia: Dawn of Darkness[/url].

[From [url=https://elseth.itch.io/of-frost-and-flowers]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
在盖亚的早期世界中，使用魔法的能力是由出生决定的，在魔法使用者和非魔法使用者之间造成了裂痕。

然而，尽管存在分歧，一个组织挺身而出，其目标是让每个人都能接触到魔法：Crysmalia项目。

故事从阿尔托（Alto）开始，她是一名工匠，加入泽萨尼亚的骑士团寻找她失踪的儿时朋友。然而，加入他们后，阿尔托偶然发现了一个她不应该知道的秘密，现在她的生命岌岌可危。

OFAF是 [url=http://elseth.itch.io/crysmalia-dawn-of-darkness]Crysmalia: Dawn of Darkness[/url] 的前传。

[来自[url=https://elseth.itch.io/of-frost-and-flowers]itch.io[/url]]
